name: United Spirits Ltd.
about: United Spirits Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures, sells, and distributes alcoholic beverages and other allied spirits in India and internationally. The company offers alcoholic beverages, such as Scotch whisky, Indian made foreign liquor whisky, malts, tequila, brandy, rum, vodka, and gin under the Godawan, McDowell's No.1, Royal Challenge, Royal Challenge American Pride, Signature, Antiquity, Black Dog, Director's Special Black, McDowell's Rum, McDowell's Brandy, and McDowell's X-series brands. It also imports, manufactures, distributes, and sells alcoholic beverages under PIPA, Don Julio, Singleton, Tanquery, Captain Morgan, Johnnie Walker, J&B, Baileys, Lagavulin, Talisker, VAT 69, Black & White, Smirnoff, and Ciroc brands. verdict.label: Looks expensive
reasons: Price implies ~28% a year profit growth for 10 years, versus ~13% that history and analysts support (reverse DCF at 10.8% cost of equity).
PE of 56 is near the bottom of its range over the last 3 years (median 64), though that is a short history to judge by.
Trades at PE 56 vs sector median 40; peers with similar ROCE and growth trade nearer 37, so the premium is not explained by fundamentals alone.
Since 2023, the price gain has been earned: earnings grew 15% a year while PE moved 55 → 56.
